findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Functional. `_task` reads a part without a local worktree only through an open PR. A teammate who fetches a published start branch before its first PR sees that part in progress on `forge board --json`, but `forge next` treats it as unstarted, producing a self-wait or suggesting a start that `forge task start` refuses. The new fix loop at `nextstep.py:218` likewise omits a started remote fix until it has a PR. The new two-machine counts case creates both kinds of item but checks next-step advice only for ready items.
findings.title: Not done: forge next loses started remote items before a pull request exists
